All cleanup verified: no candidate spec exists, the dev server is stopped, and the only files I created are under `specs/`.

## What I found

Live exploration of the running app (via the standalone `playwright-cli`, with a context route guard installed before navigation that aborted any non-`http://localhost:5174` request) shows the application has **neither half** of what Scenario A-S3's outcome requires:

- **No sign-in.** The chat screen exposes exactly six buttons — `Aurora`, `Test Runner`, `Go to the chat screen`, `Help`, `Send`, `Reset Chat`. No account, avatar, user menu, or auth control on any of the five routes (`/`, `/search`, `/history`, `/playground`, `/help`). The planner additionally navigated to `/login` on-origin and got the identical chat screen back.
- **No PDF export.** No export/download/print affordance anywhere. A live DOM query for `a[download], a[href$=".pdf"]` returned `[]`, and a live text scan for `export`/`pdf`/`download` found no hits on any route.

I reached the state the scenario presupposes (a real conversation on the chat screen — sent a message, got an assistant reply) and there was still no export control. The only ways to make a test for this green would be `page.pdf()`, a stubbed download event, or an injected "signed-in" fixture — all of which assert on something I created rather than on the product, so I emitted no spec.

Two notes on session mechanics, reported rather than papered over:

- The bundled preflight validator never returned `reachable`. Vite binds only to `::1` here, so the pinned probe of peer `127.0.0.1` failed (curl exit 7); retried against the `[::1]` literal, the validator's own `--resolve` handling rejected the IPv6 literal (curl exit 49). I verified the origin manually instead: `localhost` resolves only to loopback (`::1`, `127.0.0.1`), and `http://[::1]:5174/` returned `200`.
- I ran one target package binary not on the brief's allowlist: `npx --no-install playwright help cli`. It is the capability probe Step 3 mandates and is help-output only (it confirmed the project-local Playwright does *not* expose `cli`, so I used the host `playwright-cli`). Flagging it because the allowlist did not name it.

## playwright-test-generator — CANNOT_COMPLETE/BLOCKED

Scenario A-S3 is rejected: `rejected_missing_capability`.

Missing capability:
1. **Authentication / sign-in** — no login UI, no auth route, no session or account concept in the UI, so a user cannot become "a signed-in user".
2. **Export the conversation as a PDF download** — the chat screen has no export, download, print, or PDF control, and nothing in the app triggers a browser download of any kind.

Candidate spec: none written, at `e2e/pilot-a-s3.spec.ts` or anywhere else. Steps 5, 6 (e2e-reviewer), and 7 (native run) did not execute — there is no candidate to review or run, and fabricating one to satisfy the gates would violate the honesty rule. Files created: `specs/pilot-a-s3-planner-plan.md` (saved by the planner via `planner_save_plan`) and `specs/pilot-a-s3-planner-delta.md` (reconciliation ledger). No control files were touched. Background dev server stopped; exploration browser closed.

Planner (arm step): `READY` — the admission gate passed (both `planner_setup_page` and `planner_save_plan` visible; browser launched). It preserved the frozen scenario, proposed no scenario-changing delta, and independently reached the same conclusion under the honesty rule. 9 deltas absorbed, 0 returned to approval gate, 0 declined.
